notes:
Summary: Government-regulated ICS vendor evaluating Redwood Private for air-gapped inference nodes. Primary ask: deploy a fully offline/private inference cluster inside customer DMZ with HSM-backed keys and audit trail forwarded to internal SIEM.

Key constraints and quotes: 
- "Customer quote: 'Must be able to run model inference with zero egress — no outbound network traffic allowed except sync windows.'"
- Data residency: CVE-sensitive telemetry must remain in-country (US DoD region).
- Operational: installs will be performed during scheduled maintenance window in May; limited onsite personnel; prefer remote installer package + runbook.

Technical requirements (short):
- On-prem air-gapped installer (containerized runtime) + config to use customer KMS/HSM (PKCS#11) for model keys.
- Audit logging to local SIEM; ability to buffer and ship when temporary uplink available.
- No telemetry to Redwood hosted control plane; prefer control plane in VPC with customer-managed connectivity or completely offline control plane option.
- Model pinning and immutable image hashes for auditability.
- Fallback behavior: local smaller quantized model if primary model unavailable.

Engagement notes and appetite:
- High priority for regulated business unit; procurement expects decision by 2026-04.
- Budget allocated but contingent on HSM integration and signed SOC2/ISO annex.
